A light comic scene from a warm, old-fashioned television space adventure: adult actors on a practical starship lounge set, just after the Captain's formal speech to his crew.

Close on the Captain, surrounded by admirers, a hand resting on his shoulder. He soaks in the attention: his pleased smile widens into a broad, delighted grin as he glances to the officer on one side. Then he turns his eyes directly into the camera lens, holds the look for a moment, and gives one slow, deliberate wink with a single eye, the other eye staying open, still grinning. He holds the grin, looking into the lens, until the end. He does not speak. The camera holds still.

Sound: soft happy murmurs of the officers beside him and the quiet room. No music, no narration, no clear spoken lines. No subtitles, captions or on-screen text.
